invariants.rationale: The method constructs and returns a new HoodieWriteMetadata instance, so result should never be null.
A HoodieWriteMetadata returned from a bulkInsert should always contain a non-null list of WriteStatus objects.
The instantTime should represent a valid timestamp and should not be null or empty.
The input list of hoodieRecords should not be null for a bulk insert operation.
The HoodieEngineContext parameter must be non-null for the execution of the method.
